name: Public home page shows real plans from the database
description: The landing page renders featured plans sourced from the database rather than placeholder content.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /
Assert the page loads without an error and shows a plans or pricing section listing at least one named plan with a price.

name: Plans page lists all three connection types
description: The public plans page groups plans under Dial-Up, Broadband and Telephone.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Plans
Assert the page lists plans and that the three connection types Dial-Up, Broadband and Telephone all appear on the page.

name: Services page loads
description: The public services page renders without error.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Services
Assert the page loads with a heading and no error message.

name: Contact form submits and confirms
description: A visitor can send a contact message and sees a confirmation.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Home/Contact
Fill the name field with Test Visitor, the email field with visitor@example.com, and the message field with a short enquiry sentence, then submit the form
Assert the submission is accepted and a success confirmation is shown rather than a validation error.

name: Contact form rejects an empty submission
description: Submitting the contact form with no data shows validation messages instead of saving.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Home/Contact
Submit the form without filling any field
Assert validation messages are shown and the form is not accepted.

name: Order tracking with an unknown order id fails gracefully
description: Tracking a non-existent order shows a clear message rather than an error page.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Orders/Tracking
Enter the order id 99999999999 and submit the tracking form
Assert the page responds with a clear not-found message and does not show a server error or a crash.

name: Unknown URL shows the branded 404 page
description: A missing address renders the branded error page rather than a default server page.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /this-page-does-not-exist
Assert the page shows the branded 404 screen with the heading 'Page not found' and a link back to the home page.

name: Wrong password is rejected without a crash
description: Signing in with a wrong password keeps the user on the login page with a clear message.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login
Type admin@nexus.example into the AccountIdOrEmail field and WrongPassword123 into the Password field, then submit
Assert the browser stays on /Account/Login, an incorrect credentials message is shown, and no server error page appears.

name: Admin signs in and lands on the admin dashboard
description: Admin credentials open the admin dashboard.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login
Type admin@nexus.example into the AccountIdOrEmail field and Nexus@2027 into the Password field, then submit
Assert the browser lands on /Admin/Dashboard and the admin sidebar is visible.

name: Retail signs in and lands on the retail dashboard
description: Retail credentials open the retail dashboard.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login
Type retail@nexus.example into the AccountIdOrEmail field and Nexus@2026 into the Password field, then submit
Assert the browser lands on /Retail/Dashboard and no login error is shown.

name: Technical signs in and lands on the technical dashboard
description: Technical credentials open the technical dashboard.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login
Type technical@nexus.example into the AccountIdOrEmail field and Nexus@2026 into the Password field, then submit
Assert the browser lands on /Technical/Dashboard and no login error is shown.

name: Accounts signs in and lands on the billing dashboard
description: Accounts credentials open the billing dashboard.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login
Type accounts@nexus.example into the AccountIdOrEmail field and Nexus@2027 into the Password field, then submit
Assert the browser lands on /Accounts/Dashboard and no login error is shown.

name: Logout ends the session
description: After signing out a protected page can no longer be opened.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login
Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Open the account menu in the top bar and click Sign out
Navigate directly to /Admin/Dashboard
Assert the browser is sent back to /Account/Login and the admin dashboard is not shown.

name: Signed-out visitor cannot open a protected page
description: A protected address redirects an anonymous visitor to the login page.

planSteps.description: Navigate directly to /Admin/Dashboard without signing in
Assert the browser is redirected to /Account/Login and the dashboard content is not shown.

name: Retail user is refused the admin-only screens
description: Signs in as a Retail account and confirms the Admin-only plan, vendor, purchase order and staff screens show the access denied page instead of real data.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login
Type retail@nexus.example into the AccountIdOrEmail field and Nexus@2026 into the Password field, then submit the sign-in form
Assert the browser has left /Account/Login and landed on /Retail/Dashboard
Navigate directly to /Admin/Plans
Assert the plan list is not served. The page must show the access denied screen headed 'Access denied', and must not contain any control for adding or editing a plan.
Navigate directly to /Admin/Vendors
Assert the vendor list is not served and the access denied screen is shown instead.
Navigate directly to /Admin/PurchaseOrders
Assert the purchase order list is not served and the access denied screen is shown instead.
Navigate directly to /Admin/Organisation
Assert the outlet and staff screen is not served and the access denied screen is shown instead.

name: Technical user is refused the admin-only screens
description: The Technical role cannot reach plan management, vendors or organisation settings.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login
Type technical@nexus.example into the AccountIdOrEmail field and Nexus@2026 into the Password field, then submit
Assert the browser landed on /Technical/Dashboard
Navigate directly to /Admin/Plans
Assert the access denied screen headed 'Access denied' is shown and no plan list is visible.
Navigate directly to /Admin/Settings
Assert the access denied screen is shown and no settings form is visible.

name: Accounts user is refused plan management
description: The Accounts role can bill but cannot manage the product catalogue.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login
Type accounts@nexus.example into the AccountIdOrEmail field and Nexus@2027 into the Password field, then submit
Assert the browser landed on /Accounts/Dashboard
Navigate directly to /Admin/Plans
Assert the access denied screen headed 'Access denied' is shown and no plan list is visible.
Navigate directly to /Admin/Inventory/Products
Assert the equipment catalogue management screen is not served to this role.

name: Customer cannot open staff screens
description: A customer account is refused the staff dashboards and registers.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login
Sign in as bilal.khan@example.com with the password Nexus@2026
If the sign-in fails, sign in as ayesha.siddiqui@example.com with the same password instead
Navigate directly to /Admin/Dashboard
Assert the admin dashboard is not shown and the access denied screen is displayed instead.
Navigate directly to /Reports
Assert the reports screen is not served to a customer account.

name: Admin can create a new plan
description: A new plan saved from the admin screen appears in the plan list.

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Plans and start creating a new plan
Fill the plan name with E2E Probe Plan, choose the Broadband connection type, and set a recurring price, then save
Assert the plan list now contains E2E Probe Plan.

name: Admin can edit an existing plan
description: Editing a plan persists the change.

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Plans and open the first plan for editing
Change the plan name by appending the suffix Probe, then save
Assert the plan list shows the edited name.

name: Call tariff is only offered on metered plans
description: The call tariff field appears for Dial-Up and Telephone plans but is hidden for Broadband.

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Open the plan editor at /Admin/Plans and select the Broadband connection type
Assert the call tariff control is not visible for a Broadband plan.
Switch the connection type to Telephone
Assert the call tariff control becomes visible.

name: Admin can create a vendor
description: A new vendor saved from the admin screen appears in the vendor list.

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Vendors and start creating a new vendor
Fill the vendor name with E2E Probe Vendor and the contact details, then save
Assert the vendor list now contains E2E Probe Vendor.

name: Admin can create an equipment product with a preferred vendor
description: A product can be saved with a preferred vendor attached.

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Inventory/Products and start creating a new product
Fill the product name with E2E Probe Router, set a price, choose a vendor in the preferred vendor field, then save
Assert the product list contains E2E Probe Router and that the preferred vendor is shown against it.

name: Purchase order receiving increases stock
description: Raising and receiving a purchase order moves the ordered quantity into stock.

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Inventory and note the current quantity of the first product
Navigate to /Admin/PurchaseOrders, raise a purchase order for that product with a quantity of 5, then receive it
Assert the order is marked received and the product quantity has increased by 5.

name: Admin can add an outlet and a staff member
description: Outlets and staff can be created from the organisation screen.

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Organisation and create a new outlet named E2E Probe Outlet
Assert the outlet list contains E2E Probe Outlet.
Create a new staff member attached to that outlet
Assert the staff member appears in the staff list.

name: A city can be added and then stopped from serving
description: City records can be created and their serving state toggled.

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Settings/Cities and add a city named E2E Probe City
Assert E2E Probe City appears in the list as serving.
Stop serving E2E Probe City and then turn it back on
Assert the city can be turned back on and ends in the serving state.

name: Retail can place a new order
description: A retail user can register a customer and place an order end to end.

planSteps.description: Sign in as retail@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Orders/New and complete the customer and connection details for a new order
Submit the order
Assert the order is accepted and an order id is shown, and no validation error blocks the submission.

name: Till-date register shows all four retail views
description: The retail register exposes orders, connections, billing and payments.

planSteps.description: Sign in as retail@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Retail/Register
Assert the page loads and all four sections - orders, connections, billing and payments - are reachable on it.

name: Advanced search filters narrow the results
description: The advanced search screen accepts multiple filters and returns matching rows.

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Search/Advanced
Apply a filter for a customer name and submit the search
Assert the results table updates and no server error appears.

name: Search by account id returns the matching customer
description: Looking a customer up by account id shows that customer.

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Retail/Search and search for the account id R0000000000001
Assert at least one result row is returned and the search does not error.

name: Survey queue and feasibility run
description: The technical queue runs the feasibility rules for an order.

planSteps.description: Sign in as technical@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Operations
Assert the survey queue lists pending orders.
Open the first pending order and run the feasibility check
Assert a feasibility result is produced and shown against the order.

name: Connection status can be changed from the operations screen
description: The connections list allows a lifecycle status change.

planSteps.description: Sign in as technical@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Operations/Connections
Assert the connections list loads and shows at least one connection with a status.
Open a connection and change its status through the provided control
Assert the change is accepted without an error.

name: Overdue policy screen lists billing-driven status changes
description: The overdue policy screen shows connections affected by unpaid bills.

planSteps.description: Sign in as technical@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Operations/Overdue
Assert the page loads and explains the 15 day and 45 day inactivity thresholds.

name: Stock can be adjusted from the inventory screen
description: An inventory adjustment changes the recorded quantity.

planSteps.description: Sign in as technical@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Admin/Inventory and note the quantity of the first product
Adjust that product quantity by minus one and save
Assert the displayed quantity decreased by one.

name: Monthly billing run generates bills
description: Running billing for a period creates bill records.

planSteps.description: Sign in as accounts@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Accounts/Dashboard
Run the monthly billing action for the current month
Assert the run reports how many bills were generated and does not error.

name: A generated bill shows service tax
description: Bills carry the service tax line required by the specification.

planSteps.description: Sign in as accounts@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Open an existing bill from the billing screens
Assert the bill breakdown shows a service tax line and that the total equals the taxable amount plus that tax.

name: Raise a one-off replacement charge
description: A replacement charge can be raised against a connection and appears as pending.

planSteps.description: Sign in as accounts@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Accounts/Charges
Raise a replacement charge against the first available connection with an amount of 500
Assert the charge appears in the pending charges table with the amount 500.

name: A pending charge is refused when the amount is missing
description: The charge form validates its required fields.

planSteps.description: Sign in as accounts@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Accounts/Charges
Submit the raise-charge form with no description and no amount
Assert validation messages are shown and no charge is added to the pending table.

name: Call metering entry is accepted
description: Call minutes can be recorded for a landline connection.

planSteps.description: Sign in as accounts@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Accounts/Calls
Assert the call metering screen loads and lists billable landline connections.

name: Customer dashboard shows only the signed-in customer's data
description: A customer account does not see another customer's records.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login
Sign in as bilal.khan@example.com with the password Nexus@2026
Assert the customer dashboard loads and shows the signed-in customer's own name.
Assert no other customer's name or account id is listed on the page.

name: Customer can open the connection and billing pages
description: The customer portal pages render for a signed-in customer.

planSteps.description: Sign in as bilal.khan@example.com with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Customer/MyConnection
Assert the connection page loads and shows the customer's line details.
Navigate to /Bills
Assert the bills page loads and does not show another customer's bill.

name: Customer feedback is accepted
description: A customer can submit feedback and gets a confirmation.

planSteps.description: Sign in as bilal.khan@example.com with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Feedback and submit a short feedback message
Assert a thank you confirmation is shown after submitting.

name: Customer profile update is saved
description: Changing the profile details persists them.

planSteps.description: Sign in as bilal.khan@example.com with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Profile and change the phone number to 03001234567, then save
Assert a success confirmation is shown and the phone number field still shows the new value after the page reloads.

name: Search fields resist a SQL injection attempt
description: A quote-laden search string is handled as plain text.

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Retail/Search and search for the literal text ' OR 1=1 --
Assert the application responds normally with no results or a no-match message, and that no database error or full table dump is shown.

name: Text fields resist a script injection attempt
description: A script tag entered into a form field is stored and shown as text, not executed.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Home/Contact
Fill the name field with the literal text <script>alert(1)</script> and complete the other fields, then submit
Assert no alert dialog appears and the page continues to respond normally.

name: Required fields block an incomplete order
description: The new order form refuses an empty submission.

planSteps.description: Sign in as retail@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Orders/New and submit the form without filling any required field
Assert validation messages are shown and no order is created.

name: The signed-in area is reachable by keyboard alone
description: Keyboard users can skip to the main content and reach the navigation.

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Press the Tab key once from the top of the page
Assert the skip link becomes visible as the first focusable element.
Activate the skip link
Assert focus moves to the main content region.

name: Mobile viewport navigation opens and closes
description: At a phone width the sidebar opens from the menu button and closes again.

planSteps.description: Resize the viewport to 390 by 844 pixels
Sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Tap the sidebar toggle button
Assert the sidebar becomes visible.
Close the sidebar using its close control
Assert the sidebar is hidden again.
